Collaborative Creative Workflow

How I work with clients step-by-step to bring their concepts to life.

01

Concept Brief

We discuss your guidelines, references, dimensions, and visual requirements to map out the overall project direction.

02

Rough Sketch

I draft black-and-white layouts and poses. You review and recommend adjustments to composition before refinement.

03

Lineart & Colors

I draw clean inks and apply flat color palettes. We verify coloring and shading tone matches your ideal mood.

04

Polish & Deliver

Applying lighting adjustments, post-processing, and exporting high-resolution, print-ready files with all source layers.
